item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.2 improves C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript analysis
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.2 is available with a new C++ regular-expression parser and analysis improvements for C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript. The update applies to the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.3 adds source modeling for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue, and updates several GitHub Actions queries for better accuracy. It is a CodeQL release used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub
